What the trajectories show

After 50 simulated cycles, the flagged Batch_1 sites keep 92.3–92.6% of their capacity vs 95.2–96.1% for the typical sites. They crack 77–91 times vs 22–33, because they contain more and larger Si particles. This is an illustrative model with uncalibrated literature parameters: compare the sites with each other and do not read the numbers as predictions. No site is used as a reference.

Each site: a 58 µm wide crop of the BSE segmentation, 50 cycles at 1C, 3 random seeds. Images show seed 0; curves show the mean of the seeds with the min–max band.

    Generated by analytical_benchmarks/simulate.py (image-based chemo-mechanical model: Li diffusion in Si, Si +280% and graphite +10% volume expansion, 2-D plane-strain finite elements, Weibull-type cracking, SEI growth, isolation of small Si fragments) and viewer.py. All parameters are uncalibrated literature values; the bright BSE phase is assumed to be Si (not EDS-confirmed); binder is counted with graphite; image rows are assumed to be the coating-thickness direction. Use it to compare sites, not as a lifetime prediction. No site is treated as an approved reference.
